purpose: Reusable non-authorizing evidence-validation components for selecting and validating current applicable evidence without creating the underlying authority state.

components.name: Current Applicable Verification Record Selector

inputs.current_binding: non-secret KV/SKAP current-verification binding projected by the authoritative verification domain
inputs.candidate_records: zero or more already-admitted owner-authorization plus admission-receipt pairs evaluated only inside the selector
inputs.operation_context: task/COSV/purpose/context against which current applicability is evaluated

outputs.verification_provenance: existing non-secret KV/SKAP verification provenance projection for the exactly selected candidate
outputs.selected_record_ref: opaque reference derived from exact selected source digests; raw owner authorization and receipt are not returned
outputs.selection_evidence: non-secret exact digest bindings and decision metadata

components.authority_owner: KV/SKAP Vault for user-verification state; TV/TVC for admitted credential-receipt semantics
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: Deterministic for identical inputs. Retry only with a newly observed authoritative current binding or a changed candidate set; never fall back to latest-by-time selection.

components.name: SV_CHANGE Base-State Readback (B1)

inputs.repository: local git repository (clone) holding the bound main commit and refs/stegverse/organization-ledger, fetched by the caller's existing transport
inputs.bound_main_commit: 40-hex main commit the caller binds; the repository's own registry file (REGISTRY_PATHS) is read at exactly this commit
inputs.main_ref: ref whose history must contain bound_main_commit (default refs/heads/main)
inputs.hb_epoch: optional --hb-epoch cross-check only (ASCII digits >= 32); the epoch is read from the bound ledger head receipt; a malformed value or one differing from the verified sealed epoch -> DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH with hb_epoch and hb_epoch_source sealed (detail expected_hb_epoch, supplied_hb_epoch_well_formed, flag_failure_code HB_EPOCH_FLAG_MISMATCH; supplied_epoch_failure_code HB_EPOCH_INVALID when malformed); an unobservable ledger-head epoch -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED whatever is supplied; given explicitly as "", "null" or UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED (both slots null); omitted entirely -> no cross-check, ALLOW with cross_checked false and hb_epoch_cross_check HB_EPOCH_NOT_CROSS_CHECKED (deliberate: optional cross-check, not the admission supplied epoch; P1 @ae8b105d placement)
inputs.repository_name: the repository the clone is of (e.g. StegVerse-org/.github); selects its registry path from the pinned REGISTRY_PATHS map; unmapped -> REGISTRY_PATH_NOT_DECLARED (no default path)

outputs.base_ref: {registry_generation, ledger_head}: the registry generation at bound_main_commit and the organization-ledger ref commit
outputs.sources: [{file, blob_sha}] for the repository's registry file at bound_main_commit, refs/stegverse/organization-ledger:HEAD.json and the head receipt receipts/<hex>.json
outputs.disposition: ALLOW, or FAIL_CLOSED carrying failure_code, failed_predicate, required_evidence_or_repair, retry_entrypoint, owning_existing_goal (StegVerse-org/.github#164) and next_attempt
outputs.result_sha256: sha256 seal over the canonical receipt
outputs.hb_epoch: ADMISSION_HB_EPOCH_IS_THE_BOUND_LEDGER_HEAD_EPOCH: str($.hb_reference.epoch) of the sealed stegverse.organization-transition-receipt/v1 at the bound ledger head (HEAD.json -> receipts/<hex>.json), only if the epoch is an int (not bool) >= 32 and derived_from_clock is exactly false (org-kernel/kernel.py:68-74, blob ffec5d64; = P1 #3264 fc19b532 base_ledger_head_epoch); else FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED; sealed with the receipt; never minted
outputs.hb_epoch_source: {ledger_head: <commit40>, receipt: receipts/<hex>.json (the head receipt's ledger_store key), field: $.hb_reference.epoch}, sealed with hb_epoch on ALLOW and on DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH; on every FAIL_CLOSED hb_epoch is null and hb_epoch_source is present and null (never omitted). Field names are fixed (Lane B #46 consumes them)

components.authority_owner: The Task Registry (generation, via the main branch) and the organization ledger writer (ref) own the state; this component only reads it.
components.retry_or_reentry_semantics: Deterministic for an identical repository state, bound commit and expected hb_epoch. No schedule, loop, clock or retry: the admission caller invokes it when it needs a base binding and re-invokes after the refusal's next_attempt is satisfied.
